title: My Old House Key Went WARM 🔑
description:
In our town, a key goes warm when somebody's waiting for you behind its door. The pizza guy's keys are always warm.

I still have the key to the blue house on the hill, the one we sold nine years ago. On Monday it went warm. By Wednesday I needed an oven mitt.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: How long was the key warm before I noticed? Look at the very first shot.
